'''Revelation Score one for Her Highness''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 14 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rescue The Princess
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 RTP Revelation LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Princess Leia-the TRUE Phantom Menace.

The published list has 71 cards.

== Strategy ==

I know what you?re thinking! Just play with six lift tubes, after all, they?re higher destiny, and you?ll never use LTE again after pulling yours, right? Wrong! In the endgame you can play LTE to put the Lift Tube back in your used pile, for one extra life force. When you still need your Lift Tube, simply play LTE to look through your deck for a tube- counting your cards while you do it, then having a nice 5 to track. Anyway, on the first turn deploy Artoo to Y4 db, and use LTE to get a Lift Tube to D* db. Transit R2 to D* and tube him to the Corridor. Second turn, Free Leia, tube to the db, and transit to Y4 db. At this point he will come down on Leia. You SHOULD have deployed somebody to back her up. Use Fallen Portal to take out the opposition. If her guard happens to be lightsaber-wielding, play a Clash and Blaster Proficiency as well as Fallen Portal and completely decimate her attackers. Turn 3-flip. Turn 4- move to db. Turn 5- go after opponent. If he doesn?t have a docking bay out, use your Spaceport one to go after him. This deck is particularly hard on BHBM, Hunt Down, Watto, AOBS, and Combat. Shewski: Activation is NOT low, have you forgotten the docking bays and R2's gametext? Bacta Tank isn't so important in this deck. The Death Star Plans are way fast when you use them with a lift tube, and Secret Plans is NOT a problem when you track the right cards! To think after trading you my Boba Fett you could be so mean...Maybe I'll play with a coule AJR. Fallen Portal is BROKEN. Take out Iggy and R3 Fett with a Portal, leaving lone Tarkin, and see what I mean. Karrde: Okay...TTO? You mean people play that? OHMYGOSH I'M SHOCKED!!! And SYCFA??? If I encounter some of these decks regularly, I'll put some space in. Otherwise...
